play_contract.fault_law: Fault tiles return the player to the last mounted crown without erasing mounted progress.
play_contract.finish_law: The permanent anchor accepts the player only after all five crowns are mounted in order.

claim_boundary: This is an offline playable and inspectable representation of the frozen Five Crowns lineage. It does not emulate or boot the x86 kernel and does not replace the QEMU receipts.
